title: Coordinate cross-team signoff and redact sensitive items for customer-facing release notes
creator: Nora Chen
description:
Objective: Produce a single, polished customer-facing release note for the April runtime patch and an internal digest for partner-facing staff. Scope includes: drafting copy, redacting implementation/internal-only details, coordinating legal and security signoff, scheduling embargoed publication, and kicking off translations.

Deliverables: 1) Final public release note (short blurb + detailed changelist), 2) Internal release digest (with rollout timeline and escalation contacts), 3) Signoff checklist and audit trail.

Acceptance criteria: public note approved by PM, Tech Lead, Legal, and Security; sensitive endpoints and internal debug URLs removed or redacted; translations queued with vendor and target languages confirmed; publication scheduled in Console and docs site with correct tags and metadata.

Notes: This ticket coordinates content only. Engineering will supply final changelist lines and a verification statement that no customer-facing behavior changed beyond documented entry. Design will supply one screenshot and microcopy for the Console banner.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Nora Chen: Created ticket. Drafted initial public blurb and internal digest outline. Attached initial changelist from ENG-3984 (WIP).
2026-03-11 - Asha Patel: Pulled latest runtime changelog from staging; flagged two entries that reference internal-only telemetry endpoints. Marked for redaction.
2026-03-12 - Legal (J. Alvarez): Reviewed draft; requested removal of metric names and customer identifiers. Suggested alternate phrasing for the KV-cache change to avoid implying SLA changes.
2026-03-12 - Security (R. Singh): Confirmed no export-controlled content but requested that the internal rollout checklist remain internal-only. Added requirement for KMS note to be high-level.
2026-03-13 - Design (L. Martinez): Provided Console banner mock and recommended microcopy. Uploaded assets to Drive.

2026-03-14 - Asha Patel: Incorporated redactions and updated the public blurb. Sent to translations vendor for TAT estimate (expected 3 business days). Requested final engineering signoff on affected APis by 2026-03-17.
signoff_matrix: PM: Asha Patel (requested) - pending; Engineering TL: Priya Rao - pending final diff approval; Legal: Javier Alvarez - approved 2026-03-12; Security: Rohan Singh - approved 2026-03-12; Design: Lucia Martinez - approved 2026-03-13; Localization lead: Mei Tan - translations queued. Publication owner: Marketing (TBD).
public_changelog_snippet: April 2026 runtime patch: Performance improvements to model KV cache handling, reduced median token latency for common chat workloads, and expanded model variant routing for lower-cost fallbacks. No changes to public APIs or billing behavior. See full notes for details.
internal_notes: Embargo rules: Do not publish before 2026-03-22 09:00 PT. Internal digest includes rollout window per region, escalation contacts (oncall rotation and engineering owner), and the canary plan. Keep the internal digest in the private Release folder and tag as 'internal-only'.
publication_plan: 1) Final signoffs by 2026-03-17; 2) Localization complete by 2026-03-19; 3) Schedule Console banner and docs site for 2026-03-22 09:00 PT; 4) Send customer email for major customers (sales to own recipient list) within 2 hours of publish; 5) Push timeline to #releases and update status dashboard.
post_release_checks: Engineering to confirm runtime node metrics stable for 48 hours post-publish; PM to run quality smoke tests against 3 canonical prompts; Marketing to verify links and UTM parameters in the email. Any regression reported escalated per SRE runbook.
audit_trail_instructions: Keep a copy of all signoff emails and link PRs in this ticket. After publish, attach the final published HTML (public) and the internal digest PDF to the ticket. Tag with release-2026.04 for traceability.
